Title: Gemini and Bedrock providers
Description: As a desktop user, I want to choose between Claude, Gemini, and Bedrock as my AI provider so that I can use the model that works best for me. The app supports Google Gemini via Google.GenAI 1.13.0, Claude on Bedrock via AWSSDK.BedrockRuntime with IAM Identity Center SSO, and per-run provider/model picker. Token estimates are shown before extraction runs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Settings screen allows provider selection (Claude, Gemini, Bedrock)
Gemini provider uses Google.GenAI 1.13.0 with API key from Credential Manager
Bedrock provider uses AWSSDK.BedrockRuntime with IAM Identity Center SSO
Bedrock requires no static AWS keys; uses session credentials from SSO
Per-run model picker shows available models for selected provider
Token estimator calculates prompt + expected output tokens before extraction
Token estimate is displayed in the Extract Knowledge screen
All three providers produce compatible knowledge item structure
Each batch shows provider and model in History
End-to-end check: run same folder with each provider and verify batches appear with correct provider/model
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Implementing Gemini and Bedrock providers alongside the existing Claude provider. Gemini uses the official Google SDK; Bedrock uses AWS SDK with IAM Identity Center SSO for secure credential handling. Per-run provider/model selection and token estimation.
